tldr: Chinese open-weight labs spent August pricing themselves directly against Claude, with an Aug 19 comparison putting a 4x price gap between Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6/Qwen 3.8 Max, and Zhipu's GLM-5.3-Flash undercutting Claude and GPT on price by Aug 31.
whats_new: Anthropic answered the pricing pressure directly on Sep 2, cutting Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1's cache price 75% while shipping 70% more output tokens.
why_it_matters: The price gap competitors were using to win on cost just narrowed sharply — re-run your cost comparisons against the new cache pricing before assuming Claude remains the expensive option in your stack.

status.detail: After a month of competitors pricing against Claude on cost, Anthropic's Sep 2 Fable/Mythos 5.1 release pairs a 75% cache price cut with 70% more output tokens.

beats.headline: A 4x price-gap comparison puts Claude Opus 5 well above GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen 3.8 Max
Zhipu's GLM-5.3-Flash undercuts Claude and GPT on price, not on hardware
Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1 ships a 75% cache price cut and 70% more output tokens

open_questions: Does the 75% cache-price cut apply to all Claude models and tiers, or only Fable/Mythos 5.1?
After the cut, how does Claude's effective per-token cost compare to GLM-5.3-Flash's domestic-chip pricing?
take_for_builders: Re-run your Claude vs. GLM-5.3-Flash/Qwen 3.8 Max cost comparisons using the new 75% cache-price cut before deciding where to route traffic on price alone.
